adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, the method `feed_key` computes a Redis key (`"feed-modified:..."`) but is never called anywhere in the diff. The actual polling logic in `poll_feed` always does `SimpleRSS.parse open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url)` and iterates all items with no ETag/If-Modified-Since or other skip mechanism. So the method is dead/misleading and the job will refetch the full feed every hourly run.
